title: 怀旧午后阳光
prompt: a pillow fort in the backyard, shaded by a big old tree. Sunlight filters through the leaves, and a young boy and his golden retriever naps beside a tray of lemonade and cookies. Wind chimes tinkle gently in the breeze. Warm afternoon light, playful and nostalgic, children's book illustrated feeling
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作怀旧童书风格的温暖场景，适合故事书插画、贺卡或家庭主题品牌设计，捕捉阳光后院与惬意小憩的纯真魅力。
